description: coaxial-fuse's rod moved off the tube's axis by one to two tolerances (1e-7), turned about its middle so its ends move one or two, or grown by one: the rod's wall and the bore's, coincident at the contact, now cross or touch within a tolerance or two all round. Arris fails: a piece of the rim that matches no piece of the coincident cap's boundary (Fault::CommonBlock; one off), a piece with no interior point at its clearance (Fault::Split, NoInterior; one and a half off, grown by one), a rim circle a hair off the cap's plane with no closed form (OpError::Unsupported; two off), a section edge ending at a node nothing else reaches (Fault::Split, Dangling; the turn by one) and an edge used once (Fault::Builder, EdgeUses; the turn by two). The desired result is a clean union: the full cylinder within the tolerance, the generic body beyond (plans/c3-tolerance-apart step 1, the band survey)
